note: Which site price keys come from the Netquor API price catalog (https://api.netquor.com), and exactly how. Reviewed by hand: a key is listed here only when it can be derived from a published price book without guessing. Every other key in prices.seed.json is MANUAL and is never touched by the catalog worker: the keys under vpn., network., homeassistant. and digitalaccess. change only by a signed snapshot (webhook or operator). Rules: flat_micros = the sku's structure.amountMicros / 10000 (must divide exactly, else the key is refused); fleet_month = the kind's monthlyCents; fleet_year = monthlyCents x annualMonthsPaid; fleet_lifetime = fleet_year x lifetimeAnnualMultiple; fleet_dedicated = the dedicated block's field. Fleet rules read the engine entry fleet.device-packs, structure.config.
